description: Check a claim about an insider open-market buy (ticker/issuer, person, amount, timeframe) against the filed record. Returns status=confirmed with the source filing(s) + link; not_found; partial (same insider/company but value/date differs, itemised claimed-vs-filed); out_of_scope (sales/options/grants aren't covered); or out_of_coverage (outside the collected window). Every response states the coverage window checked. Rule-2: no estimates, no unlabelled partial matches — absence is reported as absence, never guessed.

amount_usd.description: Claimed purchase value in USD (matched ±5% or ±$1)

date.description: Claimed date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD (matched ±3 filing days)

end.description: Window end (ISO) if the claim is a range

issuer_name.description: Issuer/company name (use if you don't have the ticker)

person.description: Insider name in any order, e.g. 'Alfonso de Angoitia'

start.description: Window start (ISO) if the claim is a range

txn_type.description: Optional; only open-market buys are covered — sale/option/grant returns out_of_scope

name: verify_insider_purchase
title: Verify an insider-purchase claim against SEC Form 4
